title: Positive density of Collatz convergence at every rate above 3/log(4/3)
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of eighteen selected Phase 1 statements, led by a single positive lower natural-density constant for the set of positive integers reaching 1 within c log x ordinary Collatz steps, valid for every fixed c > 3/log(4/3). It also covers fixed-target hitting, the exact target criterion, individual-root consequences, vanishing-clock-loss variants, depth-eleven density bounds, exact finite fan allocation, real-moment comparison, target profiles, and bounded actual reference entropy with explicit tail estimates and zero normalized growth.
